$comment: sf-admin-notifications, standard simai.smart-component 1.4 (vocabulary 1.1.5): the admin's list of notifications in the panel and on the history page. Owner decision C421 (with C331, C340-C342); study ui-control control/research/2026-11-22-admin-shell-study, sample prototypes/admin-shell-study/shell.mjs setupNotifications. Data over the admin menu's port (simai.admin-navigation-port notifications.load, notifications.read) or the setting items.

look.summary: panel: the latest, in the notifications panel (sf-drawer on the right, C340), with «Вся история» and «Настройки уведомлений» at the foot. page: the history page, the whole width, in parts with «Показать ещё».

group-by.summary: day: the host's days («Сегодня», «Вчера») with the repeats of one object folded (C421). object: one group per object (a server, a site), in the host's order, nothing folded.

fold.summary: Within a day, the notifications of one object after its first fold under «Ещё N по …», a quiet link row at the start of the first one's text.

history-href.summary: The address of the history page: «Вся история» at the panel's foot.

settings-href.summary: The address of the notification settings; empty takes the port answer's settings_href.

heading-level.summary: The level of a day's heading where the list is placed.

items.x-markup: the attribute takes the same list as JSON; the property wins
items.summary: The notifications given by the page, for a host without a port: each {key, title, when, unread, href, icon, body, object, level, resolved, group, group-label}, grouped by group in order. Given, the list reads no port.

unread.x-summary: the number of unread notifications, as the host last said (or counted in items)

open.summary: A notification's link was pressed (vocabulary open): the list marks it read; not cancelled, the browser follows the link.

read.summary: Notifications were marked read (vocabulary read): the ones opened.

read-all.summary: «Прочитать все» marked every notification read, not only the ones shown.

load-more.summary: «Показать ещё» asked the host for the next part (look page).

failed.summary: The host did not answer notifications.load, or the port has no notifications; the list says so and offers «Повторить».

refresh.summary: Reads the list again (notifications.load); with items, draws them again.

read-all.summary: Marks every notification read (notifications.read {all: true}) and moves the focus to the count.

read.summary: Marks the named notifications read (notifications.read {keys, all: false}).

add.summary: A notification the page adds at the top (a run that failed): with items it joins them; over the port the host has it already, and the list reads again.

load-more.summary: The next part of the history (look page): notifications.load {cursor}.

relations.name: cl-icon
$comment: A notification's level glyph is sf-icon; a tag the list renders is a tag it fetches.

relations.name: cl-alert
$comment: A list the host could not load says so in sf-alert; not on screen when the page starts.

accessibility.x-keys: Links and native buttons: Tab reaches them, Enter (and Space on the buttons) presses. «Ещё N по …» holds aria-expanded and keeps the focus when it opens or closes. The count is a polite status; after «Прочитать все» the focus moves to it.

x-summary: The admin's notifications: grouped by day with the repeats of one object folded under «Ещё N по …», one problem one entry ending «→ решено», «Прочитать все», the panel's latest or the history page in parts; over the admin menu's port or as items.
x-decisions: shape: a leaf. Glyphs are sf-icon, the buttons sf-button, the failure sf-alert; the panel around it is the page's or the menu's sf-drawer (C340), not the list's.

data (C421): the admin menu's port, so the bell's number and the list read one host. The list takes a port handed to it, asks for one (sf-host-port-request, owner admin-notifications), or takes the sf-admin-menu's own when the menu has one. After a read it asks the menu to read its navigation again, so the bell follows.

port 1.1.0 gap: the port's notification has key, title, body, when, unread, icon, href and no object, level or resolved, which the folding, the level glyph and «→ решено» need. The list reads them when a host sends them; a port 1.2.0 that declares them is asked of the SIMAI Framework (port contracts live in ui-source).

folding (C421): within a day, the entries of one object after its first fold under «Ещё N по <object>», a quiet link button at the start of the entry's text, the 1/3 rung's height; it keeps the focus when it opens.
events: open {key, href} (vocabulary, cancelable: not cancelled, the link is followed), read {keys}, read-all, load-more {cursor}, failed {reason}.

item.const: A notification: key, title, when, unread, href, icon, body (the port's), and object, level (error|warning|info|success), resolved when the host sends them.

empty.description: What an empty list says instead of the default sentence.

untrusted_inputs: titles, bodies and objects (drawn as text)

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-admin-notifications inside the notifications panel (sf-drawer size 2 on the right) and on the history page (look page) of an admin.
do_not: Do not keep notifications in the element; the host keeps them
Do not count unread in the page: the host answers unread
Do not send markup in titles

accessibility.focus: Links and buttons in reading order; «Ещё N по …» keeps the focus; after «Прочитать все» the focus goes to the count (role status).
